text:
Neither `AskUserQuestion` nor `ExitPlanMode` is available in this session, so I'll close in text rather than with the plan-mode tools.

If you want this applied concretely, tell me which repo you mean — the candidates under your working directories are `projects/shortwright` (the only one with an actual `requirements.txt`), plus `team-lib/integrations/ai-digest`, `team-lib/integrations/consumer-deals`, `projects/ping`, `projects/bidscout`, and `projects/jkh-personal-finance`, which are already on `pyproject.toml`. I'd want to read the existing manifest and Dockerfile before proposing the specific split, since whether you already have package metadata changes the first step substantially.
